info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Delete P2m By Param1-spec
info.description: The Settlement Account Deletion API allows for the removal of specific settlement accounts identified by a unique parameter. This operation is essential for maintaining accurate and up-to-date financial records by enabling users to delete obsolete or incorrect accounts. Typical consumers include financial institutions and service providers who need to manage their settlement accounts effectively. The API ensures administrative users can streamline account management processes by removing unnecessary data artifacts.

delete.description: This endpoint allows users to delete a settlement account identified by its unique account number. Ensure that the account is not linked to any active transactions or dependencies before proceeding with the deletion.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to delete the specified settlement account identified by ACC-200045. Ensure that you provide the necessary information to confirm the deletion process.

204.description: Request successfully completed; no content returned.

DeleteP2mByParam1Request.description: This schema represents the body of a DELETE request for settlement account operations. The body is expected to be a plain string.

metadata.description: Metadata information related to the operation.

DeleteP2mByParam1Response_204.description: Response schema for the DELETE operation on settlement account, with metadata information.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme uses Bearer tokens, specifically in the JSON Web Token (JWT) format, for authentication. Clients must include a valid JWT in the Authorization header when making requests to secure endpoints.
